intent: Screen historical announcement and category membership evidence; do not reacquire the 598-work corpus.
requests_allowed: At most one official abstract page per anomalous work; official help documentation and at most four targeted search queries. No API/OAI harvest, monthly corpus download, PDF, holdout or provider switch.
acceptance_checks: Per-ID evidence must distinguish submission timestamp from first public announcement; unresolved exact availability stays null.
Population proof must cover all historical cs.SE members, including ones absent from the 2026 query; nine positive cases cannot prove completeness.
A dated snapshot or announcement archive must have capture provenance, coverage through cutoff, documented membership semantics and reproducible checksums before any dependent acquisition.
Current metadata last-modified datestamps and replay hashes are not historical-public-availability evidence.
stop_rule: If screened official interfaces expose current state/version submission history without a verified historical category capture, report INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and present owner alternatives; do not silently lower E3.
gate_effect: None; E3/#70 remain NOT_PASSED; D07-D09 remain PROPOSED.
